description: npm dependencies (Dependabot cannot run pnpm 12 in its sandbox) and GitHub Actions, pinned to digests. A PR that fails build:check needs `pnpm fix` committed on its branch; one that changes plugins/tipee/server also needs a version bump in plugin.json and SERVER_VERSION, which CI enforces once the version is released.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Effect's packages must move in lockstep (a mismatch breaks the platform layer), and its http, http-api and ai modules may change in a minor: one PR of their own. @effect/tsgo belongs to the TypeScript toolchain instead.
@effect/tsgo patches TypeScript and pins exact oxlint versions: moved apart, they break the type-aware lint (#5).
Node types follow the Node 24 runtime pinned in .node-version.
